description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body BODY] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000.
  save: --message commit subject, required, must be a single non-empty line; --body commit body, may span multiple lines; --dry-run report what would be staged and committed and change nothing.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["review", "--max-file-lines", "40", "--max-lines", "800"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and two actions", "--body", "Added a meeting note, flushed the buffer, ingested two tasks."]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write --message from what it actually shows; do not commit blind.
  `save` only ever adds a commit: it never amends, rebases, resets, checks out, or pushes.
  Exit 1 if --message is empty or spans multiple lines (put detail in --body), if the vault root is not a directory or not the root of its git repository, or if the underlying git call fails.
